title: 大壩接縫灌漿~Dam contraction-joint grouting
focus: 接縫封拱、灌漿體積與荷載傳遞驗證~Joint closure grouting, volume accounting and load-transfer verification
summary: 本課以大壩接縫灌漿為入口，深入接縫封拱、灌漿體積與荷載傳遞驗證。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Dam contraction-joint grouting as its entry point, this course examines joint closure grouting, volume accounting and load-transfer verification. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 自由熱收縮敏感度固定單塊長24 m與α=10⁻⁵/K，只將均勻降溫量由12增至18 K。ΔL=αLΔT由2.88增至4.32 mm，增加50%。比較保持自由收縮邊界；若塊體受到拘束，額外冷卻可能轉化為應力而非相同的位移，兩塊之間的接縫實際開度還取決於各自運動和接觸狀態。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For free-contraction sensitivity, hold block length at 24 m and α=10⁻⁵/K fixed, increasing only uniform cooling from 12 K to 18 K. ΔL=αLΔT rises from 2.88 to 4.32 mm, or 50%. The comparison retains free contraction; restraint may turn added cooling into stress rather than the same displacement, while actual joint aperture depends on both blocks and their contact state.
history: 壩體接縫灌漿把分開澆築的混凝土塊連成預定傳力系統，結構封拱與既有止水修復是不同目的，課程將兩者證據分開並比較水力與力學性能。重力壩設計專書出版，提供混凝土分塊與接縫背景。 工兵團拱壩設計手冊出版，提供封拱與三維傳力背景。 工兵團灌漿技術手冊出版，作材料與驗證方法參照。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。~Dam-joint grouting connects separately placed blocks into an intended load-transfer system. Structural closure and repair of existing waterstops have different purposes; this course separates their evidence while comparing hydraulic and mechanical performance. Gravity-dam design guidance is published, providing context for concrete blocks and joints. USACE arch-dam guidance is published, supporting closure and three-dimensional load-transfer context. USACE Grouting Technology is published as a reference for materials and verification methods. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

units.anchor: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度~Cooling contraction and joint aperture
units.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度~Cooling contraction and joint aperture
units.mechanism: 分塊混凝土冷卻會收縮，接縫灌漿時的溫度決定後續可用的接觸狀態。自由收縮估算只給幾何尺度，實際開縫還受基礎約束、相鄰塊體與非均勻溫度控制。 假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。 表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。接縫閉合也可能只是局部接觸，並非全高同時形成傳力面。~Cooling contracts concrete, and the thermal state at joint grouting influences later contact. Free contraction provides a geometric scale, while foundation restraint, neighboring blocks and nonuniform temperature determine actual aperture and its spatial distribution. Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks. Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. Local joint closure can also occur before full-height contact, leaving an incomplete load-transfer surface despite a closed reading at one elevation.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks.
units.verify: 對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。~Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients. Check instrument zeros independently and compare observed aperture against free-contraction scale to identify the effect of restraint and differential block movement.
units.failure: 表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。接縫閉合也可能只是局部接觸，並非全高同時形成傳力面。~Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. Local joint closure can also occur before full-height contact, leaving an incomplete load-transfer surface despite a closed reading at one elevation.
units.misconception: 用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。~Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint.
units.practice: 以冷卻收縮與接縫開度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cooling contraction and joint aperture, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients. Check instrument zeros independently and compare observed aperture against free-contraction scale to identify the effect of restraint and differential block movement.

units.anchor: 分區接縫的體積平衡~Compartment grout-volume balance
units.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡~Compartment grout-volume balance
units.mechanism: 接縫灌漿應以分區幾何、管路容積和實際回流建立收支。平均開度乘面積只是初估，止漿邊界、鍵槽和局部接觸會造成體積分布不均。 假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。~Joint grouting requires compartment geometry, line storage and measured returns in its volume account. Mean aperture times area is only an estimate because seals, shear keys and localized contact create uneven available volume. Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference. Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference.
units.verify: 逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。以獨立秤重交叉查供漿量。~Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Compare high-take regions with aperture maps and boundary-seal records to distinguish geometry, escape and metering discrepancies. Cross-check delivered volume by independent weighing.
units.failure: 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。~Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling.
units.misconception: 供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。~Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled.
units.practice: 以分區接縫的體積平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。以獨立秤重交叉查供漿量。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compartment grout-volume balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Compare high-take regions with aperture maps and boundary-seal records to distinguish geometry, escape and metering discrepancies. Cross-check delivered volume by independent weighing.

units.anchor: 殘留通道與立方敏感性~Residual channels and cubic sensitivity
units.title: 殘留通道與立方敏感性~Residual channels and cubic sensitivity
units.mechanism: 少量未填通道可能控制整個接縫的滲漏，因薄縫層流對開度呈立方敏感。封堵體積百分比與水力改善百分比沒有固定對應，連通路徑比平均孔隙更重要。 假設相同寬度、長度和壓差的平行縫，開度0.3降至0.1 mm，理想水流比(0.1/0.3)³=0.03704，減少96.296%；牛頓層流且無旁通。 局部裂縫紊流、粗糙與壓力張開都會偏離立方律，旁路還可能繞過已填區。若把理想降幅當成材料保證，會漏掉真正控制滲漏的最薄弱連通段。~A small unfilled channel can control joint leakage because laminar thin-gap flow scales with aperture cubed. Filled-volume percentage does not have a fixed relationship to hydraulic improvement; connectivity matters more than average void fraction. Assume equal width, length and pressure difference with aperture reduced from 0.3 to 0.1 mm. Ideal flow ratio is 0.03704, a 96.296-percent reduction for Newtonian laminar flow without bypass. Turbulence, roughness and pressure-induced opening violate the cubic idealization, while bypasses avoid treated regions. Treating the ideal reduction as a material guarantee misses the weakest connected segment that actually governs leakage.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設相同寬度、長度和壓差的平行縫，開度0.3降至0.1 mm，理想水流比(0.1/0.3)³=0.03704，減少96.296%；牛頓層流且無旁通。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal width, length and pressure difference with aperture reduced from 0.3 to 0.1 mm. Ideal flow ratio is 0.03704, a 96.296-percent reduction for Newtonian laminar flow without bypass.
units.verify: 在相同水頭下比較前後滲流並追蹤各分區出口，核對是否把水轉移到未量測通道；用示蹤到達時間和溫度訊號交叉查連通性，避免只依總集水量估算殘留開度。~Compare leakage at matched head and trace compartment outlets to detect diversion into unmeasured paths. Cross-check connectivity using tracer travel time and temperature signals rather than inferring residual aperture from total collection flow alone.
units.failure: 局部裂縫紊流、粗糙與壓力張開都會偏離立方律，旁路還可能繞過已填區。若把理想降幅當成材料保證，會漏掉真正控制滲漏的最薄弱連通段。~Turbulence, roughness and pressure-induced opening violate the cubic idealization, while bypasses avoid treated regions. Treating the ideal reduction as a material guarantee misses the weakest connected segment that actually governs leakage.
units.misconception: 填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。~Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent.
units.practice: 以殘留通道與立方敏感性編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在相同水頭下比較前後滲流並追蹤各分區出口，核對是否把水轉移到未量測通道；用示蹤到達時間和溫度訊號交叉查連通性，避免只依總集水量估算殘留開度。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for residual channels and cubic sensitivity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare leakage at matched head and trace compartment outlets to detect diversion into unmeasured paths. Cross-check connectivity using tracer travel time and temperature signals rather than inferring residual aperture from total collection flow alone.

units.anchor: 漿柱水頭與分區壓力~Grout-column head and compartment pressure
units.title: 漿柱水頭與分區壓力~Grout-column head and compartment pressure
units.mechanism: 同一接縫內不同高程的漿壓不相同，密度與靜水頭必須和管損分開。儀表位置高於分區時，下部壓力可能大於表壓，不能把單一讀值當整片接縫受壓。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設靜止漿體密度1800 kg/m³、高差10 m，壓力差ρgΔz=176.58 kPa；若有流動、屈服或堵塞，不再等同單純靜水分布。 高黏度或正在凝結的漿體可形成非靜水壓差，分區堵塞又會隔離儀器。若僅提高泵端壓力追求讀值一致，可能在未量測區造成不預期的開縫與串漿。~Grout pressure varies with elevation inside a joint, and hydrostatic head must be separated from line losses. A gauge above a compartment can underrepresent pressure lower down, so one reading cannot describe loading over the whole interface. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume stationary grout density 1800 kg/m³ over ten metres. Hydrostatic difference is 176.58 kPa; flow, yield behavior or blockage can invalidate the simple hydrostatic distribution. Viscous or setting grout can develop nonhydrostatic pressure differences, and obstruction isolates instruments. Increasing pump pressure merely to equalize readings can create unexpected joint opening or cross-compartment flow in unmonitored regions.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設靜止漿體密度1800 kg/m³、高差10 m，壓力差ρgΔz=176.58 kPa；若有流動、屈服或堵塞，不再等同單純靜水分布。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume stationary grout density 1800 kg/m³ over ten metres. Hydrostatic difference is 176.58 kPa; flow, yield behavior or blockage can invalidate the simple hydrostatic distribution.
units.verify: 把壓力計與各區頂底高程列在同一剖面，核對漿密度與流動狀態；用相鄰量測點檢查梯度，將短時脈動、管阻與靜態高程修正分開，避免重複加減水頭。~Plot gauge and compartment elevations on one section and verify grout density and flow state. Check gradients between instruments, separating transients, line resistance and static elevation correction so head is neither omitted nor counted twice.
units.failure: 高黏度或正在凝結的漿體可形成非靜水壓差，分區堵塞又會隔離儀器。若僅提高泵端壓力追求讀值一致，可能在未量測區造成不預期的開縫與串漿。~Viscous or setting grout can develop nonhydrostatic pressure differences, and obstruction isolates instruments. Increasing pump pressure merely to equalize readings can create unexpected joint opening or cross-compartment flow in unmonitored regions.
units.misconception: 位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。~Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction.
units.practice: 以漿柱水頭與分區壓力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把壓力計與各區頂底高程列在同一剖面，核對漿密度與流動狀態；用相鄰量測點檢查梯度，將短時脈動、管阻與靜態高程修正分開，避免重複加減水頭。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for grout-column head and compartment pressure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot gauge and compartment elevations on one section and verify grout density and flow state. Check gradients between instruments, separating transients, line resistance and static elevation correction so head is neither omitted nor counted twice.

units.anchor: 析水與硬化後空隙~Bleeding and hardened voids
units.title: 析水與硬化後空隙~Bleeding and hardened voids
units.mechanism: 灌入時連續的漿體可能因析水、沉降與體積變化在上緣留下空隙。新拌材料體積並不等於硬化填充體積，分區上部尤其需要獨立證據而非只看出漿顏色。 假設新拌填充體積2.4 m³、自由析水比例5%，分離水量0.12 m³；若均集中在面積20 m²的上部水平面，等效空層6 mm，僅幾何極端示例。 小型量筒的析水比例不一定可直接放大到受限薄縫，泌水又可能沿通道外排。忽略拘束與水路會把最壞幾何空隙誤當實際缺陷，或相反漏掉局部空洞。~Initially continuous grout can leave upper voids through bleeding, settlement and volume change. Fresh volume is not hardened filled volume, and upper compartment regions require independent evidence rather than relying on the appearance of returns. Assume fresh fill 2.4 m³ and free bleeding five percent, producing 0.12 m³ water. Concentrated over an upper horizontal area 20 m², this corresponds to six millimetres of void, a geometric extreme. Cylinder bleeding does not scale directly to confined thin joints, and bleed water can leave through channels. Ignoring confinement and drainage can mistake an extreme geometric void for actual damage or overlook a localized unfilled pocket.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新拌填充體積2.4 m³、自由析水比例5%，分離水量0.12 m³；若均集中在面積20 m²的上部水平面，等效空層6 mm，僅幾何極端示例。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fresh fill 2.4 m³ and free bleeding five percent, producing 0.12 m³ water. Concentrated over an upper horizontal area 20 m², this corresponds to six millimetres of void, a geometric extreme.
units.verify: 以現場同溫同齡期樣品量析水與沉降，記錄容器形狀對結果的影響；把分區頂部回流與後續接觸檢查對照，辨認自由水滯留、材料收縮和真正未充填的差別。比較受限薄縫試體的結果。~Measure bleeding and settlement in samples at matched temperature and age, recording container effects. Compare upper-compartment returns with later contact checks to distinguish retained free water, material shrinkage and genuinely unfilled regions. Compare results from a confined thin-gap specimen.
units.failure: 小型量筒的析水比例不一定可直接放大到受限薄縫，泌水又可能沿通道外排。忽略拘束與水路會把最壞幾何空隙誤當實際缺陷，或相反漏掉局部空洞。~Cylinder bleeding does not scale directly to confined thin joints, and bleed water can leave through channels. Ignoring confinement and drainage can mistake an extreme geometric void for actual damage or overlook a localized unfilled pocket.
units.misconception: 只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。~Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening.
units.practice: 以析水與硬化後空隙編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以現場同溫同齡期樣品量析水與沉降，記錄容器形狀對結果的影響；把分區頂部回流與後續接觸檢查對照，辨認自由水滯留、材料收縮和真正未充填的差別。比較受限薄縫試體的結果。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for bleeding and hardened voids, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure bleeding and settlement in samples at matched temperature and age, recording container effects. Compare upper-compartment returns with later contact checks to distinguish retained free water, material shrinkage and genuinely unfilled regions. Compare results from a confined thin-gap specimen.

units.anchor: 溫度與材料反應速率~Temperature and reaction rate
units.title: 溫度與材料反應速率~Temperature and reaction rate
units.mechanism: 灌漿材料的可用時間和強度發展受溫度影響，固定鐘錶時間不能代表相同反應程度。簡化反應速率可比較溫度敏感性，但實際配方、摻料與早期反應需要試驗校正。 假設表觀活化能40 kJ/mol，R=8.314 J/(mol·K)，以293.15 K為基準，303.15 K速率比exp[(40000/8.314)(1/293.15−1/303.15)]=1.718；非凝結時間保證。 材料反應不是全程單一速率，外加劑可改變誘導期，桶內發熱也會讓試體失去代表性。直接用理論倍率縮短施工等待時間，可能誤判材料可操作性與承載能力。~Temperature changes grout working time and strength development, so equal clock time does not imply equal reaction progress. A simplified rate model compares sensitivity but requires calibration for mixture composition, admixtures and early-age reactions. Assume activation energy 40 kJ/mol and R=8.314 J/(mol·K). Relative rate at 303.15 K versus 293.15 K is 1.718, an idealized comparison rather than a setting-time guarantee. Reaction does not follow one rate throughout; admixtures alter induction and self-heating changes sample representativeness. Scaling waiting times directly by a theoretical ratio can misjudge workability and load-transfer capacity despite correct arithmetic.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設表觀活化能40 kJ/mol，R=8.314 J/(mol·K)，以293.15 K為基準，303.15 K速率比exp[(40000/8.314)(1/293.15−1/303.15)]=1.718；非凝結時間保證。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume activation energy 40 kJ/mol and R=8.314 J/(mol·K). Relative rate at 303.15 K versus 293.15 K is 1.718, an idealized comparison rather than a setting-time guarantee.
units.verify: 量測混合桶、輸送末端與試體溫度，將流動度和強度資料對照等效齡期；用不同溫度試驗檢查單一活化能是否適用，並保留發熱、失水與剪切歷史造成的偏差。核對試體失水與現地差異。~Measure temperatures at mixing, delivery and specimens and compare flowability and strength against equivalent age. Test whether one activation energy fits several temperatures, retaining discrepancies caused by self-heating, moisture loss and shear history. Check specimen moisture loss against field conditions.

Scaling waiting times directly by a theoretical ratio can misjudge workability and load-transfer capacity despite correct arithmetic.
units.misconception: 溫度提高十度後，所有灌漿配方的凝結時間都會固定縮短一半。~A ten-degree temperature increase halves setting time for every grout mixture.
units.practice: 以溫度與材料反應速率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。量測混合桶、輸送末端與試體溫度，將流動度和強度資料對照等效齡期；用不同溫度試驗檢查單一活化能是否適用，並保留發熱、失水與剪切歷史造成的偏差。核對試體失水與現地差異。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for temperature and reaction rate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure temperatures at mixing, delivery and specimens and compare flowability and strength against equivalent age. Test whether one activation energy fits several temperatures, retaining discrepancies caused by self-heating, moisture loss and shear history. Check specimen moisture loss against field conditions.

units.anchor: 填充層的法向柔度~Normal compliance of the filled layer
units.title: 填充層的法向柔度~Normal compliance of the filled layer
units.mechanism: 接縫傳力不只取決於漿材強度，也取決於厚度、接觸面積與閉合後的柔度。薄層線彈性估算可以比較變形量級，但局部未黏結、粗糙接觸與裂縫會讓有效剛度降低。 假設有效模數0.5 GPa、面積2 m²、厚5 mm，法向剛度EA/t=200 GN/m；壓力合力1 MN造成5 micrometres壓縮，完全接觸線彈性假設。 若有效接觸面積低於幾何面積，平均應力與剛度估算都會失真。接觸閉合具有非線性，用高載階段的斜率回推低載狀態會低估早期變形。~Joint load transfer depends on thickness, contact area and compliance as well as grout strength. A thin-layer elastic estimate compares movement scales, while debonding, rough contacts and cracks reduce the effective stiffness from the ideal value. Assume effective modulus 0.5 GPa, area 2 m² and thickness 5 mm. Normal stiffness is 200 GN/m, giving five micrometres compression under 1 MN with full elastic contact. Effective area below geometric area distorts both average stress and stiffness. Contact closure is nonlinear, so extrapolating a high-load slope to the initial low-load regime underestimates early movement and conceals gaps.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效模數0.5 GPa、面積2 m²、厚5 mm，法向剛度EA/t=200 GN/m；壓力合力1 MN造成5 micrometres壓縮，完全接觸線彈性假設。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective modulus 0.5 GPa, area 2 m² and thickness 5 mm. Normal stiffness is 200 GN/m, giving five micrometres compression under 1 MN with full elastic contact.
units.verify: 以可辨識小變形的量測配置比較載重和閉合曲線，先扣除設備與相鄰混凝土柔度；檢查卸載回線、空間分布和溫度漂移，判別材料壓縮是否混入接觸面重新貼合。檢查量測架本身的變形。~Measure load and closure with sufficient small-displacement resolution, subtracting equipment and adjacent-concrete compliance. Examine unloading loops, spatial variation and thermal drift to distinguish material compression from renewed contact between initially separated surfaces. Check deformation of the measurement frame itself.
units.failure: 若有效接觸面積低於幾何面積，平均應力與剛度估算都會失真。接觸閉合具有非線性，用高載階段的斜率回推低載狀態會低估早期變形。~Effective area below geometric area distorts both average stress and stiffness. Contact closure is nonlinear, so extrapolating a high-load slope to the initial low-load regime underestimates early movement and conceals gaps.
units.misconception: 漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。~Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness.
units.practice: 以填充層的法向柔度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以可辨識小變形的量測配置比較載重和閉合曲線，先扣除設備與相鄰混凝土柔度；檢查卸載回線、空間分布和溫度漂移，判別材料壓縮是否混入接觸面重新貼合。檢查量測架本身的變形。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for normal compliance of the filled layer, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure load and closure with sufficient small-displacement resolution, subtracting equipment and adjacent-concrete compliance. Examine unloading loops, spatial variation and thermal drift to distinguish material compression from renewed contact between initially separated surfaces. Check deformation of the measurement frame itself.

units.anchor: 封拱後的荷載分配~Load sharing after closure
units.title: 封拱後的荷載分配~Load sharing after closure
units.mechanism: 接縫填充使原本分開的塊體形成新的傳力路徑，施工先後和當時溫度會留下初始應力。平行剛度模型可示範共同位移的分擔，但不能取代三維拱壩的分階段分析。 假設兩路徑剛度30及20 GN/m、共同承受10 MN，位移P/(k1+k2)=0.2 mm，分力6與4 MN；無初始間隙和預應力的線彈性示例。 若一條路徑尚有間隙，荷載不會立即按兩個剛度分配；溫度或混凝土徐變也會重新分配內力。只以最終幾何一次加載，會漏掉施工歷程造成的初始狀態。~Filling joints creates load paths between previously separate blocks, while sequence and temperature establish initial stress. Parallel springs demonstrate compatible load sharing but do not replace staged three-dimensional analysis of an arch dam. Assume parallel stiffnesses 30 and 20 GN/m sharing 10 MN. Common displacement is 0.2 mm and forces are 6 and 4 MN, excluding initial gaps and prestress. A gapped path does not immediately share load in proportion to stiffness, and temperature or creep redistributes force. Loading only the final geometry misses the initial state created by the actual construction sequence.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩路徑剛度30及20 GN/m、共同承受10 MN，位移P/(k1+k2)=0.2 mm，分力6與4 MN；無初始間隙和預應力的線彈性示例。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel stiffnesses 30 and 20 GN/m sharing 10 MN. Common displacement is 0.2 mm and forces are 6 and 4 MN, excluding initial gaps and prestress.
units.verify: 在分階段模型中保存每步初始應變與接觸狀態，核對反力總和與共同位移；對照封拱前後應變計及壩頂位移，檢查量測變化是否與預測的新傳力路徑一致。~Preserve initial strains and contacts in staged analysis, checking reaction balance and compatible displacement. Compare strain gauges and crest movement before and after closure to test whether observed changes match the predicted new load path.
units.failure: 若一條路徑尚有間隙，荷載不會立即按兩個剛度分配；溫度或混凝土徐變也會重新分配內力。只以最終幾何一次加載，會漏掉施工歷程造成的初始狀態。~A gapped path does not immediately share load in proportion to stiffness, and temperature or creep redistributes force. Loading only the final geometry misses the initial state created by the actual construction sequence.
units.misconception: 接縫完成後的受力只取決於最終幾何，與施工順序和封拱溫度無關。~Post-grouting forces depend only on final geometry, regardless of sequence or closure temperature.
units.practice: 以封拱後的荷載分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在分階段模型中保存每步初始應變與接觸狀態，核對反力總和與共同位移；對照封拱前後應變計及壩頂位移，檢查量測變化是否與預測的新傳力路徑一致。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for load sharing after closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Preserve initial strains and contacts in staged analysis, checking reaction balance and compatible displacement. Compare strain gauges and crest movement before and after closure to test whether observed changes match the predicted new load path.

units.anchor: 壓力衰減與漏失辨識~Pressure decay and loss diagnosis
units.title: 壓力衰減與漏失辨識~Pressure decay and loss diagnosis
units.mechanism: 封閉試驗中的壓力衰減同時受洩漏導度與系統可壓縮儲量控制。衰減快未必表示大裂縫，空氣泡、軟管和結構變形都會改變儲量，需先辨認量測系統。 假設線性儲量C=0.0005 m³/kPa、漏失導度G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa)，時間常數C/G=50 s，半衰時間50ln2=34.657 s；固定邊界與單一儲量。 壓力計漂移、閥漏與漿材凝結會產生非水力衰減，單一半衰時間無法分開導度和儲量。若不獨立量測其中一項，就存在多組參數都能符合相同曲線。~Pressure decay in a closed test depends on leakage conductance and compressible storage. Rapid decay does not uniquely identify a large crack, because entrained air, flexible hoses and structural deformation change the system response. Assume linear storage C=0.0005 m³/kPa and leakage conductance G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa). Time constant is fifty seconds and half-life 34.657 seconds, with fixed boundaries and one storage compartment. Gauge drift, valve leakage and setting introduce nonhydraulic decay, while one half-life cannot separate storage from conductance. Without independent measurement, multiple parameter combinations fit the same curve and do not uniquely establish joint tightness.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性儲量C=0.0005 m³/kPa、漏失導度G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa)，時間常數C/G=50 s，半衰時間50ln2=34.657 s；固定邊界與單一儲量。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear storage C=0.0005 m³/kPa and leakage conductance G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa). Time constant is fifty seconds and half-life 34.657 seconds, with fixed boundaries and one storage compartment.
units.verify: 先用已知密閉容積校正設備儲量，記錄溫度、含氣與閥件漏失，再擬合多時段壓力曲線；比較流量收支與壓力模型殘差，確認單指數衰減是否足以描述資料。另量閥件單獨封閉的漏率。~Calibrate equipment storage with a known sealed volume and record temperature, entrained air and valve leakage before fitting pressure segments. Compare flow balance and model residuals to determine whether one exponential adequately represents the observations. Measure valve leakage separately with the joint isolated.
units.failure: 壓力計漂移、閥漏與漿材凝結會產生非水力衰減，單一半衰時間無法分開導度和儲量。若不獨立量測其中一項，就存在多組參數都能符合相同曲線。~Gauge drift, valve leakage and setting introduce nonhydraulic decay, while one half-life cannot separate storage from conductance. Without independent measurement, multiple parameter combinations fit the same curve and do not uniquely establish joint tightness.
units.misconception: 只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。~One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint.
units.practice: 以壓力衰減與漏失辨識編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。先用已知密閉容積校正設備儲量，記錄溫度、含氣與閥件漏失，再擬合多時段壓力曲線；比較流量收支與壓力模型殘差，確認單指數衰減是否足以描述資料。另量閥件單獨封閉的漏率。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for pressure decay and loss diagnosis, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calibrate equipment storage with a known sealed volume and record temperature, entrained air and valve leakage before fitting pressure segments. units.anchor: 波速檢測與接觸證據~Wave velocity and contact evidence
units.title: 波速檢測與接觸證據~Wave velocity and contact evidence
units.mechanism: 彈性波走時可協助辨認不連續區，但波可能繞行裂縫，也受含水率與溫度影響。接縫黏結與抗剪傳力不能僅由高波速推定，需與幾何和力學證據交叉查核。 假設路徑2 m、完整材料波速4000 m/s，走時500 microseconds；接縫使走時增加20 microseconds，表觀速度2/0.00052=3846.15 m/s，非黏結強度換算。 首波拾取偏差可與小接縫延遲同量級，濕裂縫也可能傳波而不傳剪。將單一路徑速度直接換成全接縫黏結百分比，會把訊號品質與材料行為混為一談。~Elastic-wave travel time helps identify discontinuities, but waves can bypass cracks and respond to moisture and temperature. High apparent velocity alone does not establish bond or shear transfer, requiring geometric and mechanical corroboration. Assume a two-metre path at 4000 m/s, giving 500 microseconds. Added joint delay twenty microseconds reduces apparent velocity to 3846.15 m/s, without providing a bond-strength conversion. First-arrival picking error can rival the joint delay, and a wet crack may transmit waves without shear capacity. Converting one velocity into a whole-joint bonded percentage confuses signal quality with actual mechanical behavior.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設路徑2 m、完整材料波速4000 m/s，走時500 microseconds；接縫使走時增加20 microseconds，表觀速度2/0.00052=3846.15 m/s，非黏結強度換算。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a two-metre path at 4000 m/s, giving 500 microseconds. Added joint delay twenty microseconds reduces apparent velocity to 3846.15 m/s, without providing a bond-strength conversion.
units.verify: 以相同耦合、溫度與含水狀態重複量測，對多方向走時做互易性檢查；把異常區與接縫開度、鑽孔觀察及載重反應對照，確認快波路徑沒有繞過待評估界面。~Repeat measurements with matched coupling, temperature and moisture, testing travel-time reciprocity in several directions. Compare anomalies with aperture, borehole observations and loading response to verify that fast paths have not bypassed the interface being evaluated.
units.failure: 首波拾取偏差可與小接縫延遲同量級，濕裂縫也可能傳波而不傳剪。將單一路徑速度直接換成全接縫黏結百分比，會把訊號品質與材料行為混為一談。~First-arrival picking error can rival the joint delay, and a wet crack may transmit waves without shear capacity. Converting one velocity into a whole-joint bonded percentage confuses signal quality with actual mechanical behavior.

units.practice: 以波速檢測與接觸證據編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以相同耦合、溫度與含水狀態重複量測，對多方向走時做互易性檢查；把異常區與接縫開度、鑽孔觀察及載重反應對照，確認快波路徑沒有繞過待評估界面。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for wave velocity and contact evidence, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer.
